links.why: cl1 (the light was good) is what God saw. It is the object of the seeing verb, not a reason. Ki after a verb of perceiving.
links.category: object clause after a verb of perceiving

links.why: Order reversed. cl0 (he saw) comes before cl2 (he separated), so the builder direction runs backwards.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative line from cl0. cl1 is inside cl0's object clause, so it is not the clause before cl2.
links.category: narrative sequence past an embedded clause

cant_tell.what: cl1 opens_with field holds a morphology code, not a conjunction
cant_tell.why: Read as having no connective. The clause is the object of cl0, so the missing conjunction does not change any link.
